title: Keep It Stupid Simple!
subHeader: Unchecked ambition is the number one killer of motivation.
body:
I started designing this version of my website in April of 2025 but I'm only publishing it now on January 1, 2026. I wanted this version of my website to be perfect, so I held off on putting it up. The scope of the project kept growing and as a consequence, it kept pushing back the launch date.

The MVP I was demanding from myself grew to something unreasonable. As a result, I just quit working on it. It transformed from something that was fun to develop into something more akin to a chore.

To fix this, I've stripped everything back to what's essential so that I can publish something, even if it's not the coolest personal website on the planet. That doesn't mean that it's not something that I can't be or am not proud of - I wouldn't put it out there if I wasn't. It means that I'm taking a better approach to actually accomplishing my goal.
